paper.title: Bayesian Optimization of CVaR with Unknown Hyperparameters

settings.name_in_paper: CVaR Bayesian optimization with unknown GP hyperparameters (finite candidate set)
unmapped: Objective is the CVaR_alpha of f(x,W) over an environmental variable W ~ P_W; regret r_t = CVaR_alpha[f(x_t,W)] - CVaR_alpha[f(x*,W)] (minimisation)
Learner actively queries a pair (x_t, w_t) on X x W and observes f(x_t,w_t) plus Gaussian noise
The learner knows the distribution P_W (represented by finitely many scenarios)
The kernel / hyperparameters are unknown; the learner knows a finite candidate set Theta of GP models containing at least one well-specified candidate theta* (f in RKHS of k_theta* with norm <= B)
settings.definition_quote: We consider an unknown objective function $f : \mathcal{X} \times \mathcal{W} \to \mathbb{R}$ ... seek a design $x$ that minimizes $x^\star \in \arg\min_{x \in \mathcal{X}} \mathrm{CVaR}_\alpha[f(x,W)]$ ... at iteration $t$ it actively selects a query $(x_t,w_t)$ and observes a noisy evaluation $y_t = f(x_t,w_t) + \varepsilon_t$, $\varepsilon_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_\varepsilon^2)$ ... we assume a finite candidate set $\Theta$ of GP models containing the unknown correct candidate $\theta^\star$

symbols.Theta_card: size |Theta| of the finite candidate set of GP models
symbols.xi_T: noise-concentration threshold 2 sigma^2 log(4|Theta| pi^2 T^2 / (3 delta))
symbols.beta_T: max over candidates of the confidence width beta_T^theta = B + sigma sqrt(2(gamma_{T-1}^theta + 1 + ln(2/delta)))

conditions: regret is cumulative CVaR_alpha regret: sum_t CVaR_alpha[f(x_t,W)] - CVaR_alpha[f(x*,W)]
f in RKHS of k_theta* with ||f|| <= B for some theta* in Theta
k_theta <= 1 for all theta in Theta
gamma_T is the maximum over candidates of the maximum information gain
tuning: xi_t = 2 sigma^2 log(4|Theta| pi^2 t^2 / (3 delta))

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Assume $f \in \mathcal{H}_{k_{\theta^\star}}$ with $\|f\|_{\mathcal{H}_{k_{\theta^\star}}} \le B$ for some $\theta^\star \in \Theta$, $\varepsilon_t \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_\varepsilon^2)$ i.i.d., and $k_\theta \le 1$ for all $\theta \in \Theta$. Set $\beta_t^\theta = B + \sigma_\varepsilon(2(\gamma_{t-1}^\theta + 1 + \ln(2/\delta)))^{1/2}$ and $\xi_t = 2\sigma_\varepsilon^2 \log(4|\Theta|\pi^2 t^2/3\delta)$. Then with probability at least $1 - \delta$, the cumulative regret satisfies $R_T \le \mathcal{O}(|\Theta| B + |\Theta|\sqrt{\xi_T T} + \beta_T|\Theta|\sqrt{T\gamma_T})$

results.notes: Restated as Theorem 5 in the appendix (same bound). The proof gives explicit constants: 2|Theta|B + 4|Theta|(sqrt(xi_T T) + beta_T sqrt(C gamma_T T)) + lower-order terms. RKHS norm bound B is mapped to S. Quantity is 'other' because the regret is defined on the CVaR risk functional. Regret is for minimisation of CVaR.
